# Start English Learning

I am ready to start today's English-learning session. Use the `english-coach` Skill and follow `AGENTS.md`.

Read the current Markdown learning records in `data/` before asking anything. Prepare and validate the complete question plan in `data/history/lessons/YYYY-MM-DD.md` before presenting the first sentence: 7 new sentences followed by 10 real reviews, or all eligible reviews if fewer exist. If today's plan already exists, reuse it and resume from the first row without a matching assessed attempt; do not regenerate it. If today's session is already completed, report its completion instead of starting it again.

Keep the plan free of English answers and hints. Present exactly one Vietnamese sentence from the plan and wait for my English translation. After each actual answer, explain and assess it, update the related learning records immediately, then wait for me to continue. Do not record generated questions as studied or invent answers or results.
